summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of James L. Bailey, a retired American professional basketball player born May 21, 1957. It describes his college background at Rutgers, his selection by the Seattle SuperSonics in the 1979 NBA Draft, and his nine-season NBA career from 1979 to 1988 across five teams. It closes with his career total of 5,246 points.
one_line: Biography of James L. Bailey, a retired American basketball forward/center who played nine NBA seasons from 1979 to 1988.
key_facts: James L. Bailey was born on May 21, 1957.
James L. Bailey is a retired American professional basketball player.
James Bailey was a 6'9" (2.06 m) forward/center.
James Bailey played college basketball at Rutgers University.
James Bailey was selected with the 6th pick of the 1979 NBA Draft.
The Seattle SuperSonics drafted James Bailey in the 1979 NBA Draft.
James Bailey spent 9 seasons in the National Basketball Association, from 1979 to 1988.
James Bailey played for the Seattle SuperSonics during his NBA career.
James Bailey also played for the New Jersey Nets, Houston Rockets, New York Knicks, and Phoenix Suns.
James Bailey ended his NBA career with 5,246 total points.
